title: Exploratory cross-sectional study on (subjective) adherence to digital health applications
summary: Digital health applications (DiGAs) are increasingly being used to support people with mental health conditions. Little research has been conducted to date into how these applications are actually used in everyday life and how users assess their effectiveness. In this study, adult users of DiGAs will be surveyed once online regarding their usage behaviour, any deviations from usage recommendations, and their subjective perceptions of the effects. The aim is to gain a better understanding of the real-world use of DiGAs and to identify starting points for the user-centred further development of digital health services.
conditions: Users of digital health applications with various indications

interventions.name: Users (current or former) of digital health applications (DiGAs) in Germany are surveyed once regarding their adherence to the recommended usage behavior.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Current or previous use of at least one digital health application authorised in Germany
• Electronic informed consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
• No use of a digital health application
• No consent to participate in the study
